packageRules.description: Plex image: pms-docker tags end in a per-release git hash (e.g. -cb3ebc72d), which the docker versioning scheme treats as an incompatible suffix — it silently drops every update. Regex versioning matches only plain <ver>-<hash> tags (rejects -arm64/-amd64/-armhf and latest). Do NOT name the hash group <prerelease> — that marks every tag unstable and ignoreUnstable drops the upgrades again.

Automerge patch/minor/digest bumps. platformAutomerge is OFF: main has no branch protection, and GitHub native auto-merge requires protected branch rules, so Renovate merges these PRs itself on its runs.
kagent 1.x needs Substrate, gVisor workers and a prepared Postgres, and starts a fresh schema. Stay on 0.x until that migration is planned (see charts/kagent/Chart.yaml).
